        mapping = {

            "S":  (0, 1),

            "NW": (-1, -1),

        dx, dy = int(round(evader_dir[0])), int(round(evader_dir[1]))
        if dx in (-1, 0, 1) and dy in (-1, 0, 1):
            return [dx, dy]

    # If territory control: move towards least controlled neighbor
    territory_dir = observation.get("territory_direction", None)
    if isinstance(territory_dir, (list, tuple)) and len(territory_dir) == 2:
        dx, dy = int(round(territory_dir[0])), int(round(territory_dir[1]))
        if dx in (-1, 0, 1) and dy in (-1, 0, 1):
            return [dx, dy]

    # Fallback: move toward center of map if available
    center_dir = observation.get("center_direction", None)

        if dx in (-1, 0, 1) and dy in (-1, 0, 1):
            return [dx, dy]

    # Final safe default: stay or random small bias away from walls is not allowed (no randomness)
    # Use best-effort neutral move
    return [0, 0]
